title: Chen Nian's Choice
next_chapter_hook: The blood-colored scene burned in Chen Nian's pupils—Chapter 799, Chen Ji collapsed in a pool of blood, the Tianji Record stained crimson, and those pair of heavenly eyes surpassing all creation coldly gazing down upon this destined-to-fail rebellion.

text.content: In the instant the door softly opened, Chen Ji almost thought he was still within the aftershock of prophecy. Moonlight poured from the eaves, outlining a slender silhouette—it was the figure he had desperately tried to grasp through countless midnight dreams. Chen Nian stood just outside the door, shed of childishness, yet her brows and eyes still held that little girl from childhood who could always see through his deceptions at a glance. Her gaze was terrifyingly calm, as if she had long known everything that would happen tonight.

dialogue.content: Brother, I've come to keep my promise.

text.content: Chen Ji's throat felt blocked by something. How many years had it been? Since the Holy Sect took Chen Nian away, he couldn't recall how many springs and autumns had cycled through search and disappointment. He thought he had long learned to seal all emotions beneath that mask of composure, yet now that mask was cracking visibly before his eyes.

dialogue.content: (Voice slightly trembling) Nian Nian... you've gotten thinner.

text.content: Chen Nian didn't speak, only gently stepping inside, moonlight forming a hazy halo behind her. Only then did Chen Ji notice that her eyes carried a faint silvery gleam—an omen appearing only when spiritual power was extremely concentrated. What alarmed him more was that when Chen Nian came within three feet of him, the Tianji Record produced a faint sense of rejection for the first time, as if some force was interfering with its operation.

dialogue.content: Brother, you can sense it, right? This排斥感. Chen Nian raised her head, silver gaze fixed directly on Chen Ji, "This is why the Holy Sect took me away—I am the Heavenly Fate Key."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Heavenly Fate Key—he had heard this name in Mo Xiansheng's fragmentary words, yet never imagined it would be related to his own sister. He recalled how every time he tried to foresee a future related to Chen Nian, the vision was always blurred like looking through a layer of mist. So it wasn't that the Tianji Record was incomplete, but rather that it was "locked" by her person.

dialogue.content: The Holy Sect spent ten years researching before finally confirming one thing: Chen Nian's existence can interfere with all prophetic-type divine abilities. The more complete the Tianji Record, the more it resembles a page soaked in ink before me.

text.content: Chen Ji's fist slowly tightened within his sleeve. He thought of the Heavenly Fate Value consumed every time he used the Tianji Record over these ten years, and that always-lingering deadly backlash hanging above his head. If Chen Nian's abilities could interfere with the Tianji Record, did that mean—she could become his trump card against fate? But the moment this thought emerged, it was drowned by an even more intense emotion: that was a guilt and heartache deeply rooted in his bones.

dialogue.content: Brother, you're thinking about using me to counter the Tianji Record's backlash, aren't you? Chen Nian suddenly smiled, that smile identical to when she caught him stealing candied hawthorns as a child, "Don't be silly, I came to help you, not to be protected by you."

choice.prompt: Faced with Chen Nian's主动请缨, Chen Ji's heart was filled with mixed emotions. He was both gratified by his sister's growth and worried about the possible costs. Mo Xiansheng had said that the price of the Heavenly Fate Key interfering with the Tianji Record was bearing equivalent fate backlash—this was not something he was willing to let Chen Nian bear.

choices.description: Chen Ji chose to categorically refuse, preferring to face the Tianji Record's backlash alone rather than letting his sister bear even a shred of risk.
choices.visible_reward: Trust Deepened Between Siblings, Chen Nian Understood His Difficulties
choices.risk_hint: The Path of Facing Tianji Record Backlash Alone Will Be More Difficult

text.content: Chen Ji spoke word by word, cold light flickering in his eyes yet quickly收敛, replaced by a warmth never shown before anyone. "I searched for you for ten years, not for you to bear fate's cost for me. If you dare harm even a single hair on yourself, I will defy heaven itself to protect you."

choices.memory_label: 拒绝陈念牺牲，展现兄长担当

choices.description: Chen Ji decided to first hear what Chen Nian's actual plan was before making a decision. Rational analysis came first, then action.
choices.visible_cost: Possibly Getting Drawn into a Larger Conspiracy
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining Complete Intelligence About the Heavenly Fate Key
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's Plan May Harbor Unknown Risks

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcing himself to regain his usual calm. "Continue." He reached out and grasped Chen Nian's ice-cold fingers. "Let me hear your plan first, then decide who should sacrifice for whom."

Chen Nian lowered her eyes, her lashes casting delicate shadows under the moonlight. She didn't pull away from Chen Ji's hand; instead, she gently squeezed back—the force was slight, yet it allowed Chen Ji to feel a long-missed warmth belonging to blood connection. In the next instant, a scorching current rose abruptly from their interlocked palms, raging through Chen Ji's meridians.

What is this... Chen Ji gazed in horror at his interlocked hands with Chen Nian. Two streams of golden and silver light surged and intertwined in a frantic dance of resonance. His spiritual energy erupted uncontrollably, spiraling upward with unprecedented intensity. The dormant golden core in his dantian began to crack, signaling an imminent breakthrough!

dialogue.content: Blood resonance... it's so powerful... Chen Nian's voice trembled, yet her eyes sparkled with unexpected joy. "Brother, I can see it now! The obscured sections of the Tianji Record have become crystal clear before my eyes!"

text.content: Chen Ji felt his ears roar as a powerful force poured through his crown, instantly shattering the bottleneck that had troubled him for years. The golden core's surface exploded with cracks, and a brilliant golden light erupted from his body, tearing off part of the room's roof. The moment he stepped into the middle stage of Golden Core, he had ironically achieved advancement through blood resonance!

dialogue.content: Congratulations, brother, on reaching the middle stage of Golden Core.

text.content: Before Chen Ji could savor his breakthrough's joy, Chen Nian's next words chilled him to the bone. Her expression appeared pale and resolute under the moonlight, her silver eyes reflecting something Chen Ji could not perceive.

dialogue.content: "Brother, I also see things you cannot." Chen Nian's voice was soft, yet each word cut like a blade. "Chapter 799—you die. You die under the gaze of the Heavenly Dao's Eye, your blood staining every page of the Tianji Record red."

text.content: The night wind suddenly turned biting. Chen Ji stood rooted in place, the shattered roof letting in a sky full of stars that fell upon his rigid face. It was the first time he felt such bone-deep chill—not from fear, but from rage. Chen Ji, who had orchestrated the world and never missed a single move, how could he die in Chapter 799?

choice.prompt: Chen Nian brought a deadly prophecy: in Chapter 799, Chen Ji would die at the hands of the Heavenly Dao's Eye. This was a future even the Tianji Record could not foresee, yet the one who held the Heavenly Fate Key had seen it. Faced with information capable of shaking his entire scheme, Chen Ji needed to make a choice.

choices.text: Face destiny head-on, overturn fate's decree
choices.description: Chen Ji decided to face the Heavenly Dao's Eye directly, even if it meant becoming enemies with an existence beyond all, he would tear apart this predetermined ending.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of prematurely triggering confrontation with the Heavenly Dao's Eye
choices.visible_reward: Gain Chen Nian's unwavering support, siblings unite to strategize
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Dao's Eye's terror far exceeds imagination, early confrontation carries extreme risk

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile appearing particularly wild beneath the shattered roof tiles. He reached out and stroked the top of Chen Nian's head, just as he had countless times when they were young. "Excellent, Niannian. Since you've seen the ending, I will tear that ending apart for you to see." His voice was low and unwavering. "The Heavenly Dao's Eye wants me dead? Then right under its very gaze, I will turn this entire chessboard of the world upside down."

choices.text: Strategically position hidden pieces, maintain backup strategies
choices.description: Chen Ji decided not to reveal his true emotions, while thanking Chen Nian, privately contemplating how to lay the groundwork for reversal before Chapter 799.
choices.visible_cost: Momentarily concealing genuine thoughts may create distance with Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Buy time to perfect the layout, hide trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may detect his disguise, affecting trust

text.content: Chen Ji's expression instantly returned to its usual calm, as if the previous loss of composure was merely an illusion. He gently patted Chen Nian's shoulder, his voice mild without a trace of波动. "Thank you for telling me this, Niannian. Leave the rest to your brother to handle." But only he knew that beneath that serene surface, mighty waves were churning—the distance of three hundred twenty-two chapters was enough for him to lay another enormous game of chess.

Chen Nian quietly watched her brother, those silver eyes reflecting his current appearance. She suddenly let out a soft sigh, that sigh carrying too many complex emotions—heartache, helplessness, and a trace of hard-to-detect pride. Her brother, after all, was still that Chen Ji who, even when facing a certain death, wanted to grasp everything in his own hands.

dialogue.content: "Brother, whatever decision you make, I will stand by your side. Like when we were little, you took the beatings for me, and I covered for you." A cunning smile curved Chen Nian's lips, and in that instant, she seemed to become that mischievous little girl again. "After all, my life as the Heavenly Fate Key is bound together with yours anyway."

text.content: Chen Ji was stunned. He suddenly realized that over these ten years of desperately trying to protect his sister, at some point she had already grown into a companion capable of standing shoulder to shoulder with him. The afterglow of Blood Pulse Resonance still flowed gently through his meridians—that was a bond that transcended all language. He reached out his hand, and this time, he chose to believe—to believe that this Bloodline Power connecting them was enough to shake the so-called Heavenly Fate.

Moonlight poured down, illuminating this dilapidated yet warm dwelling. Beyond the shattered roof, countless stars dotted the sky, as if countless eyes gazing upon the mortal world. Chen Ji knew that from this night forward, he was no longer alone. On the chessboard of the Tianji Record, there finally appeared an existence capable of sharing secrets and bearing fate together. And that inevitable Deadly Trap after Chapter 322, he would transform it into an unprecedented great reversal.
